parts.name: Screen Side
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen side of a laptop, typically made of aluminum alloy for durability and lightweight design.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the display panel and webcam, providing the visual interface for the user.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge to open or close the laptop.

parts.name: Base Side
parts.Basic_description: This is the base side of the laptop, made of aluminum alloy, containing the keyboard, touchpad, and internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the keyboard, touchpad, and internal hardware such as the motherboard and battery.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the screen side moves; it serves as the main support structure.

parts.name: Connector
parts.Basic_description: This is the connector or hinge part of the laptop, typically made of stainless steel for strength and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the screen side and base side, allowing smooth rotation and maintaining structural integrity.
parts.Movement_description: It enables rotational movement between the screen and base, allowing the laptop to open and close.
